title: A failed orders pull after a version change is never retried, so paid online orders never reach the bar
description: onlineOrdersTick sets `lastVersion = v` before it awaits syncOnlineOrders(). If that pull fails (503, timeout, network blip), the outer catch only logs the error. Every later tick sees the same version and hits `return`, and while the version endpoint answers 200 the 5-minute full-pull fallback is never reached. The paid order stays missing until another site order changes the version or someone presses Yenile on OrdersPage. That is the only client call to /sync/online/refresh; the bar screen does not trigger it.
evidence:
[online] siparişler alınamadı: Site siparişleri alınamadı (HTTP 503)
orders pulls in 15 min of ticks: 1 | paid online order on the bar screen: false
AssertionError: paid online order never ingested while the version stays the same: expected undefined to be truthy
fix: Set lastVersion only after syncOnlineOrders() succeeds (move `lastVersion = v` after the await). Also let the 5-minute full pull run even when the version endpoint answers 200, so a stuck or misread version signal cannot block ingestion.

title: A 200 with a non-JSON or unexpected body closes every open paid online order, and they are never reopened
description: fetchPanelOrders treats any 200 as success and returns `json.orders ?? []`. A 200 HTML maintenance or captive-portal page (json null), or a body without `orders`, therefore becomes an empty list. upsertOnlineOrders then marks every open online order kapali/done and its items servis. When the site recovers and lists the order again, the existing-order branch updates extStage and item status (back to 'yeni') but leaves status 'kapali'. The order drops off the open online list (onlineStatus().open = 0) while the bar screen still shows its ticket. The closing loop only scans status 'acik', so when the site later completes the order the ghost ticket is never cleaned up.
evidence:
after first sync: acik new [ 'yeni' ]
second sync (HTML 200) {"created":0,"updated":0,"closed":1}
after HTML 200: kapali done [ 'servis' ]
third sync (site back, order still new) {"created":0,"updated":1,"closed":0}
after recovery: kapali new [ 'yeni' ]
kitchen tickets for the online order: 1
onlineStatus().open (orders the POS shows as open online): 0
fourth sync (site done) {"created":0,"updated":0,"closed":0} state: kapali new [ 'yeni' ] kitchen tickets still shown: 1
fix: In fetchPanelOrders, throw unless `Array.isArray(json?.orders)`, so a malformed 200 counts as a failed sync. In upsertOnlineOrders, set status back to 'acik' (closedAt null) when a locally closed order reappears with a non-done stage. Have the closing step also consider orders whose extStage is not 'done', so they are closed and their items set to servis.

title: Cloud snapshot pushes customer phone, balance and credit limit plus delivery phone, address and full name to Vercel/Upstash
description: buildSnapshot puts orderToDTO(db, o) for every open order into `orders`. That DTO includes customer {name, phone, balance, stamps, creditLimit}, deliveryName (full name), deliveryPhone and deliveryAddress. docs/07 states that customer phone numbers never leave the café ('müşteri telefonları gitmez'), and the audit scope allows nothing beyond first names. The pickup board already reduces names to first name, but the orders map does not.
fix: Map the orders for the cloud copy through a redactor. Set customer to { id, name: first name } (no phone, balance or creditLimit). Set deliveryPhone and deliveryAddress to null and reduce deliveryName to the first name. Add a test asserting that no phone or address string appears in JSON.stringify(buildSnapshot()).

title: Menu apply ignores the signed panel's isActive=false and re-opens an item the site just marked Tükendi
description: applyMenu sets `active = true` for every item in the public menu unless portionsLeft === 0. runMenuSync fetches the signed panel menu, which is authoritative and not CDN-cached, but passes it only to previewMenu as a label, never to applyMenu. The public menu is CDN-cached (s-maxage=300). So right after a cashier marks an item Tükendi (site updated, then local), a 'Siteyle eşitle' or automatic apply re-activates it in LafPOS while the site still shows Tükendi. The audit and preview also describe this falsely as 'geri: Sitede yeniden satışta'.
evidence:
marked Mocha (mnu-0009) sold out → site: guncellendi ; site isActive now: false
apply: uygulandi changes: [{"kind":"geri",…"name":"Mocha","detail":"Sitede yeniden satışta"}]
LafPOS active after apply: true | site panel isActive: false
fix: Pass the panel map into applyMenu. When it is present, set active from panel.isActive (still forcing false when portionsLeft === 0), and use it in previewMenu for the 'geri' decision.

title: Refilling the portion counter does not re-open the product on the site, and the next sync sells it out again locally
description: When the last portion sells, addItems emits availability.push and pushSoldOut sets isActive=false on the site. When the manager refills portions in Yönetim › Menü (PATCH /admin/products/:id {portionsLeft}), only the local row is set active. Nothing is sent to the site, so online customers keep seeing Tükendi. The public menu then omits the item, so the next menu sync deactivates it locally ('kalkti: Sitede Tükendi') even though portionsLeft is 8. The product becomes unsellable everywhere.
evidence:
site pushes so far: ["mnu-0068 isActive=false (LafPOS porsiyon)"]
after refill: LafPOS active = true portionsLeft = 8 | site isActive = false | pushes: ["mnu-0068 isActive=false (LafPOS porsiyon)"]
sync: uygulandi changes: ["kalkti:Frambuazlı Cheesecake:Sitede Tükendi"]
after sync: LafPOS active = false portionsLeft = 8
fix: When a PATCH raises portionsLeft above 0 on a synced product that was inactive, route it through setAvailability(id, true), which writes to the site first, or emit an availability push with isActive=true. Alternatively, have applyMenu keep a product active when portionsLeft > 0 and push it to the site.

title: lafmaliyet sales lines merge M and L of a product that has a posName and report every cup under one slot
description: posNameFor returns product.posName regardless of size, and salesLines groups only by posName, keeping the slot and siteMenuId of the first item seen. For a two-size site product with a posName (a POS-owned field editable in Yönetim), all M and L sales collapse into one line. lafmaliyet then maps that line by site_menu_id + slot to a single recipe, so cost and stock are booked under the wrong size. The CSV loses the split as well.
evidence:
Latte mnu-0007 M 19500 L 21000
payload lines for Latte: [{"posName":"LATTE","siteMenuId":"mnu-0007","slot":"L","qty":3,"revenue":600,"isService":false}]
csv: "Ürün;Adet;Tutar\r\nLATTE;3;600,00\r\n"
AssertionError: L sales must be reported under slot L: expected 3 to be 1
fix: Group salesLines by (siteMenuId, slot) for synced items, or by posName + slot. Have posNameFor append the size suffix when the product has two sizes, even when posName is set, or support a per-size posName.

title: Service charge is missing from the product/category report and from the lafmaliyet sales list (lines sum below z_total)
description: With settings.serviceRate > 0 (an admin setting, 0-30%), masa orders carry totals.service, which is included in totals.total, net sales, the KDV breakdown and payments. productReport only sums totals.lineNet per item, which excludes service, so the 'Satış' and 'Kategori' totals are below Net ciro. salesLines (server/sync/lafmaliyet.ts:42) builds the 'Ürün;Adet;Tutar' list and the POST /api/pos/gun 'lines' the same way and never emits a service line. The lafmaliyet payload has no service field either. As a result, lafmaliyet's product revenue for the day is lower than the z_total it receives in the same payload.
evidence:
X kdv [{"rate":10,"gross":240860,"base":218964,"kdv":21896}] service 13760
product total 227100 category sum 227100
Z net 240860 lafmaliyet zTotal 2408.6 lines sum 2271
csv Ürün;Adet;Tutar / LATTE LARGE;4;810,60 / LATTE MEDIUM;4;780,00 / TÜRK KAHVESİ;5;680,40
AssertionError: product report total == net sales: expected 227100 to be 240860
AssertionError: lafmaliyet sales lines == z total: expected 227100 to be 240860
fix: Emit the service charge as its own line in salesLines (for example posName 'SERVİS ÜCRETİ', isService: true, revenue = sum of totals.service). Add a matching 'Servis' row or category to productReport, or report productReport.total and netSales side by side with the service amount, so the totals reconcile. Optionally add the service amount to the lafmaliyet z block.

title: Menu sync overwrites the manager's POS sort of synced products, which the docs list as LafPOS-owned
description: docs/03 §1 lists 'POS sırası' among the fields the sync does not touch. PATCH /admin/products/:id accepts `sort` for synced products, unlike categories, where the site's sort is explicitly locked. applyMenu still writes `sort: idx` on every update, so any manager reordering is reset on the next menu change.
evidence:
Latte synced product sort before: 6
after PATCH sort: -5
sync: uygulandi {"created":0,"updated":82,"deactivated":0}
after sync sort: 6
AssertionError: expected 6 to be -5
fix: Write sort only when inserting a product (or keep a separate siteSort column). Alternatively, reject `sort` in PATCH for synced products, the way categories do, and fix the docs.

title: A local-only Tükendi (no site key) is silently undone by the next menu sync
description: Without LAFFOGATO_SYNC_SECRET, setAvailability marks the product inactive only in LafPOS and returns site 'anahtar_yok'. The next applied menu sync, triggered by any unrelated price change on the site, forces active=true for every listed item. The sold-out item becomes sellable again, and the change is audited as 'geri: Sitede yeniden satışta' even though the site never changed it.
evidence:
marked Mocha sold out, site= anahtar_yok
active after sold-out: false
sync: uygulandi changes: ["fiyat:Matcha Latte","fiyat:L'Affogato","geri:Mocha"]
active after sync: true
adding the sold-out product after sync → HTTP 200
fix: Preserve the local active flag in applyMenu for listed items when there is no panel key, or keep a local soldOut override that only the cashier clears. Stop reporting 'geri' unless the site's state actually changed.

title: Online table orders are matched only by siteTableCode, not by the table name in the label as the docs say
description: docs/03 §2.3 says a 'table' order appears on the floor plan by 'label içindeki masa adı ya da tables.siteTableCode'. The code matches only siteTableCode, and seeded tables have none, so QR table orders whose label is the table's name land in 'others' with tableId null.
evidence:
table name: S2 siteTableCode: null
online order with label "S2" → tableId null
AssertionError: expected null to be '01M5WD77AFQ29DWVZWH7Y06Z51'
fix: Fall back to a case-insensitive (tr-TR) match of label against tables.name when no siteTableCode matches, or correct the docs.

title: lafmaliyet cashIn is clamped at 0, so opening + cash + cashIn − cashOut − handedOver no longer equals expectedCash
description: expectedCash counts payments from methods of kind 'nakit', while z.cash counts payments with zField 'cash'. Yönetim allows a method such as 'Döviz' with kind 'diger' and zField 'cash'. Then expectedCash − openingCash − cash + cashOut + handedOver is negative and is clamped to 0, so lafmaliyet's recomputed expected cash differs from LafPOS's. That breaks the equality docs/03 §4 promises.
evidence:
z: {"openingCash":1000,"cash":390,"cashIn":0,"cashOut":50,"handedOver":0,"expectedCash":1145,"countedCash":1145,"cashDiff":0}
lafmaliyet recomputed expected = 1340 vs LafPOS expectedCash = 1145
fix: Compute the cash drawer set and z.cash from the same predicate (zField 'cash' or kind 'nakit', consistently), or send a signed cash adjustment instead of clamping. At minimum, validate in admin that zField 'cash' implies kind 'nakit'.

title: Uzaktan push: signed requests can be replayed for 300 s and an older snapshot overwrites a newer one
description: verifyPush checks only the HMAC and a ±300 s timestamp window. There is no nonce or replay cache, and the stored snapshot's `at` is not compared before SET. A captured or duplicated push replayed after a newer one is accepted and rolls the patron's remote view back to stale figures.
evidence:
replay of the older push → HTTP 200
remote view after replay: at = 1000 open total = 5000
AssertionError: remote snapshot rolled back to the older one: expected 1000 to be 2000
fix: Before SET, read the stored snapshot and reject or ignore a push whose snap.at is not greater than the stored `at` (an atomic Lua script or WATCH). Optionally store each signature with a TTL of SKEW_S and reject repeats.

title: Product thumbnail fetch follows redirects to any host, which defeats the same-host SSRF guard
description: thumbSource allows only https URLs on the laffogato host, but download() calls fetch with the default redirect: 'follow'. A redirect from the site (open redirect, a rewritten image path, or a compromised menu entry) makes the café server request arbitrary internal hosts, such as LAN devices or loopback. Any image-typed response is cached and served publicly at /media/products/:id. signedFetch already uses redirect: 'error'.
evidence:
thumb returned: image/png "internal-secret-bytes"
requests that reached the internal service: ["GET 127.0.0.1:64903/private/_next/image?url=%2Fmenu%2Fx.webp&w=256&q=75"]
fix: Use `redirect: 'manual'` and follow only Location headers that pass thumbSource() (same https host), or use `redirect: 'error'` as signedFetch does.

title: Online orders that arrive before the day is opened are booked to the previous (already closed) business day
description: upsertOnlineOrders attaches new online orders to getOpenDay() ?? the latest day, even when that day is closed and belongs to an earlier business date. In the probe, an order paid on the site at 07:55 on 11-03 (business date 11-03) was stored under the 11-02 day. As a result, /reports/summary 'Online (sitede ödendi)' for 11-02 shows 2 orders / 500 TL against an expected 1 / 200 TL. 11-03 and the patron live panel show 1 against an expected 2. The stored Z for 11-02 (onlineOrders 0) no longer matches the report for the same date.
fix: Attach an online order to the day whose date equals businessDate(paidAt). If that day does not exist yet, either create the link when the day for that date opens, or report online orders by businessDate(openedAt) instead of by dayId.
